Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements audited by LIANA RAMON XENIA & REKAN, granting a full discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for the 2025 fiscal year. This approval was granted with 99.995% of the votes on May 13, 2026.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of US$1,090,090,509 in net profit, designating US$3 million for reserves, US$50 million for dividends, and US$1.037 billion as retained earnings. The remaining dividend payment of US$30 million is scheduled for May 29, 2026.
Agenda #3: Shareholders set a maximum remuneration cap of US$1,500,000 for the Board of Commissioners for the 2026 fiscal year. The authority to determine specific salary levels for both the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners was delegated to the Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #4: The company appointed the public accounting firm Liana Ramon Xenia & Rekan, a member of Deloitte Southeast Asia Limited, to audit the financial statements for the 2026 fiscal year. The Board of Directors was granted the authority to determine the associated fees.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved the restatement of Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align the Company's business activities with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI). The Board of Directors is authorized to execute the necessary legal deeds and notifications for this alignment.
Agenda #6: The meeting presented the realization reports for the use of proceeds from the 2021 Limited Public Offering III and the 2025/2026 Shelf Registration Bonds V. These reports cover the utilization of funds from Limited Public Offering III and various tranches of the Shelf Registration Bonds.
Agenda #7: The current composition of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners was confirmed, including Erwin Ciputra as President Director and Djoko Suyanto as President Commissioner. Their terms of office are set to end in May or June 2027.
Agenda #8: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk officially submitted the final summary of minutes from the 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders via its Corporate Secretary. This submission includes the finalized document titled "Summary of Minutes of AGMS 2026 - FINAL.pdf".
